headline: Patriots starting RG Mike Onwenu carted off with ankle injury
summary: Patriots starting right guard Mike Onwenu was carted off the field with an ankle injury late in the first quarter of Sunday's game against the Steelers.

headline: Packers WR Reed, RT Bako-Bewele carted off with injuries
summary: Packers wide receiver Jayden Reed and right tackle Zach Bako-Bewele were carted off the field on back-to-back plays Sunday.

headline: Jayden Reed ruled out with neck injury, Zach Bako-Bewele out with knee injury
summary: The Packers had two players leave with injuries on their opening offensive possession and both of them have been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Jets.

headline: Source: Josh Simmons is "week-to-week" with back injury
summary: Chiefs left tackle Josh Simmons, the team's first-round pick in 2025, missed the opening game of the season with a back injury.

headline: Sources: Colts' Keenan Allen faces minimum 3-game suspension
summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen, who was formally charged last week with two misdemeanor offenses stemming from his drunken driving arrest in downtown Indianapolis last month, is facing a minimum three-game suspension, sources told ESPN.

headline: Ernie Accorsi, longtime NFL executive and Giants GM, dies at 84
summary: Longtime NFL executive Ernie Accorsi, the architect of the Giants team that pulled off one of the biggest upsets in Super Bowl history, has died. He was 84.
